image_description: A side-profile view of a small turtle, likely a mud or musk turtle, walking on a reddish-brown tiled floor. The turtle has a high-domed, oval carapace that is brownish-yellow with darker seams between the scutes. The plastron (underside) appears yellowish-orange. The head is extended, showing a pointed snout and small eye. Two limbs are visible; they are short, stout, and appear to have webbing and claws. The tail is not clearly visible. The lighting creates a glossy reflection on the shell.
